paragraphs: Assabet Interactive sells four modules that libraries add to their own websites. One handles the event calendar and the registration that goes with it. Another manages online museum pass reservations and the check-out and return of passes at the library. A third streamlines meeting and study room requests.

The modules are delivered inside the library's own pages rather than on a separate site. They run on any platform, including WordPress, Drupal and Joomla. The calendar and room modules talk with each other to eliminate location and time conflicts. Staff work from one administration area and can log in from any browser with an internet connection.

The company says the features came from conversations with and requests from librarians. Its pricing pitch rests on placing no cap on how many staff members may access the modules. Data sits on secure servers with redundancy and auto-scaling to meet peak demand.
